items.title: Joe Robichaux Interview, 1959-03-19
items.q: I gave him one because I had gave Lee one and I gave Theta Poirnell one.

ctx.x: Not the one down with the river, but was that it down with the river?

No, it was right here, no, by this post office. Oh sure, yeah. Right across from there, the La Vida. The La Vida, yeah. Well we played there together, and then from there we went over to the Asturias. And we played over there Asturias and that's why we, we did the recording down here at the Italian Hall on Esplanade Street. And we had, we had our regular band, but we had Albert Morgan on bass. He wasn't playing with us, he was playing on a boat with Faith Marble, which he was a good piano player too at those…
Yeah, there's still, there's one of those, the Tip Easy blues is still out I think.
